name: feature
description: Understand, design, implement, test, review and document a new feature.

tasks.title: Understand the requirement
tasks.instruction: Understand what is being asked: {goal}. Read the relevant code and report the existing patterns and constraints a design must respect. Do not change any files.

tasks.title: Design the approach
tasks.instruction: Propose a concrete approach for: {goal}, based on the findings above. Name the files that will change and why. Do not change any files.

tasks.title: Run the tests
tasks.instruction: Run the project's tests and report the result exactly. Quote any real failure output; never report a pass you did not observe.

tasks.title: Review the change
tasks.instruction: Review the diff for correctness. Give a concrete failing scenario for each finding. End with exactly one line: 'VERDICT: approved' or 'VERDICT: changes-requested'.

tasks.title: Document the change
tasks.instruction: Document what changed and why, for someone who was not here: {goal}. Describe the behaviour, not the diff.
